summary: The zek account calls AI the most transformational technology in history, is not worried about AI safety and defends a right to own compute.

statements.quote: very soon owning GPUs will be no different then owning automatic weapons.
the best part of living in the era that will spawn super intelligence is watching people become devoid of the things they claim give them meaning.
people would be less anti ai if they realized modern life was built on the very things they are so fearful about.
there is no AI bubble. it’s the most transformational technology in human history.
anti-democratization of intelligence is feudalist. way worse.
